description: This class includes the manufacture of raw sugar, refined sugar, powdered sugar, syrup and molasses from sugar cane, sugar beets, maple sap and other sources.
includes: manufacture of raw sugar from sugar cane or sugar beet
manufacture of refined cane or beet sugar in solid form
manufacture of powdered and icing sugar
manufacture of sugar syrups and molasses
manufacture of maple syrup and sugar
manufacture of glucose and glucose syrup from sugar
excludes: manufacture of glucose, glucose syrup from starch, see 1062
